WITH recorded_months AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, ym.Date, ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    WHERE ym.Date >= '201301' AND ym.Date < '201401'
)
SELECT
    c.Segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS total_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rm.CustomerID) AS customers_with_a_row,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rm.Consumption IS NOT NULL THEN rm.CustomerID END) AS customers_with_a_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rm.Consumption > 0 THEN rm.CustomerID END) AS customers_with_a_positive_value,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN rm.Consumption = 0 THEN 1 END) AS zero_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN rm.Consumption < 0 THEN 1 END) AS negative_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN rm.CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND rm.Consumption IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN rm.Date NOT GLOB '2013[01][0-9]' OR rm.Date > '201312' THEN 1 END) AS malformed_month_rows
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN recorded_months AS rm ON rm.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY c.Segment

SELECT
    c.Segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ym.CustomerID) AS customers_who_consumed_fuel
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN yearmonth AS ym
    ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    AND ym.Date >= '201301'
    AND ym.Date < '201401'
    AND ym.Consumption IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY c.Segment
